# Slice shift

Cuts the frame into horizontal (or vertical) slices that slide out of line by random amounts, re-cutting a few times a second.

<EffectDemo effect="slice-shift" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { sliceShift } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/slice-shift';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(sliceShift({ preset: 'subtle' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.slices = 12`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type    | Default | Range   | Description                                                            |
| ---------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `slices`   | number  | `12`    | 2 – 80  | Number of slices across the frame.                                     |
| `offset`   | number  | `0.08`  | 0 – 0.5 | Largest slide, as a fraction of the frame.                             |
| `density`  | number  | `0.4`   | 0 – 1   | Fraction of slices out of place at any moment.                         |
| `rate`     | number  | `2`     | 0 – 2.5 | Re-cuts per second for each slice (kept below 3 for photosensitivity). |
| `vertical` | boolean | `false` |         | Vertical slices that slide up and down.                                |
| `seed`     | integer | `0`     | 0 – 99  | Picks a different pattern of slices.                                   |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                     |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle`    | `offset: 0.02`, `density: 0.25`              |
| `shattered` | `slices: 40`, `offset: 0.15`, `density: 0.6` |
| `vertical`  | `vertical: true`, `slices: 16`               |
| `frozen`    | `rate: 0`, `density: 0.5`                    |

Apply one with `sliceShift({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Glitch & signal · tracked as story X6.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`density: 0`) without changing your settings.
- **Size:** 6.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/slice-shift`, including the shared effect runtime.

Original implementation (MIT). References: Hash-driven slice offsets with staggered per-slice timing.
